Maria H.: Found a legacy backup tar in gs-bucket: bkup-2023-11.tar.gz that includes what looks like S3 creds (access_key + secret) inside a config file. The blob holding the tar is KMS-wrapped (ciphertext). Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-9123 :rotating_light:
Tony L.: Can you paste the object path and KMS key ARN? Need to know if it's our customer KMS or partner.
Maria H.: gs://redwood-archive/backups/bkup-2023-11.tar.gz
KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-legacy-wrap
Priya K.: Are the creds valid? Could they be stale? If valid, rotate immediately and block access.
Maria H.: Quick check: they matched an active service user in IAM (svc-legacy-backup). Last used: 2024-11-03 02:12 UTC. So they're live. :grimacing:
Albert S.: Immediate containment: revoke svc-legacy-backup keys, rotate IAM creds, remove read on the bucket for that principal. Jay P. and Eng-oncall-bot, please hold any restore jobs touching that bucket.
eng-oncall-bot: Noted. Pausing scheduled restores for redwood-archive (next run canceled).
Jay P.: On it. Removing principal from bucket ACLs now.
Emily R.: We need to decide about the KMS wrapping key. If we just rotate the IAM creds, the KMS ciphertext stays fine. But if we rotate/delete the wrapping key, older ciphertext becomes unreadable unless rewrapped.
Priya K.: Agreed. Plan: 1) Rotate the exposed IAM creds 2) Snapshot and rewrap the ciphertext to a new KMS key under our key rotation policy 3) Audit decrypt calls and list who decrypted the object 4) Revoke and schedule deletion of old key only after rewrap complete.
Tony L.: Rewrapping plan — do we have a rewrap tool? For AWS KMS you can decrypt (with old key) and re-encrypt with new key. For large archives we should stream rewrap to avoid double storage.
Albert S.: Example rewrap pattern:
```
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://obj.cipher --output text --query Plaintext | base64 --decode > obj.plain
aws kms encrypt --key-id alias/new-wrap --plaintext fileb://obj.plain --output text --query CiphertextBlob | base64 --decode > obj.rewrapped
```
We can pipeline this with `aws s3 cp - s3://...` to avoid full local disk.
Maria H.: Important: backups are ~500GB for that prefix. We'll coordinate with infra for a streaming rewrap job.
Jay P.: I'll open infra ticket to spin a temporary rewrap instance with high network egress in us-west-2.
Priya K.: Also need to check Vault transit usage: some teams used Vault to wrap keys before storing. Check Vault audit logs for wrap/unwrap events.
Emily R.: Action items:
- Maria H.: isolate the object + snapshot (blocked access) (done)
- Tony L.: rotate IAM creds for svc-legacy-backup and create replacement service account (ETA 30m)
- Jay P.: infra ticket for rewrap job + estimate (ETA 1h)
- Albert S.: KMS usage audit / CloudTrail filter (ETA 45m)
- Priya K.: Vault audit log grep for `unwrap` on that blob or key (ETA 45m)
- Emily R.: Notify legal/customer-data if any customer PII in backups (ETA immediate)

Tony L.: Rotated IAM creds and created new svc-backup-v2. Old access keys revoked. :white_check_mark:
Maria H.: Confirmed no restore jobs ran while old keys were active since revocation (checking logs now).
Albert S.: CloudTrail shows 6 Decrypt calls for that key from svc-legacy-backup between 2024-11-02 and 2024-11-03. We'll include IPs in the audit.
Priya K.: Vault logs show no transit unwraps in the same window — looks like KMS handled the wrapping, not Vault.
Jay P.: Infra ticket created: INFRA-5467. Rewrap job scheduled on t3.2xlarge; will stream and write to a new bucket prefix with encryption alias/new-wrap. Estimated completion 3 hours.
Emily R.: Legal notified and asked for scope; no PII flagged by automated scan so far. Will follow up.
Maria H.: We're going to avoid destroying the old KMS key for 30 days post-rewrap to allow any missed archives to be rewrapped.
Tony L.: RBAC follow-up: propose policy change to disallow IAM user credentials for service principals — enforce IAM Roles + STS only for backup flows.
Priya K.: +1. Create RFC and schedule for next week's infra WG.
Maria H.: Final checklist before close:
- rewrap complete
- audit log pack + indicator of decryption sources
- rotate any other creds found in same tar
- update backup runbook with key rotation steps
- legal signoff

Jay P.: Rewrap completed in 2h40m. New objects in s3://redwood-archive/rewrap-2024-11/ with alias/new-wrap. MD5s match.
Albert S.: Audit pack uploaded to SEC drive: https://drive.redwood.com/SEC/SEC-9123-audit.zip
Emily R.: Legal confirmed no customer notification required, internal memo only.
Maria H.: Thanks everyone. Closing out and moving to post-incident review next week. :lock: :white_check_mark:
Tony L.: Can we add a periodic scan for plaintext creds in archived backups? I can schedule a job.
Priya K.: Please do. Add to SRE runbook.
Maria H.: Closing thread — will attach postmortem draft to SEC-9123.
